message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through our old go-bags, and you know what? I actually felt a little proud. For once, I was the one who had everything ready—snacks, water, even a few important documents tucked away safely. I smiled thinking back to all those times I wished I was prepared during little emergencies. It’s funny how being ready can bring such peace of mind. Have you ever felt that little thrill of being the prepared one?
